Admin routes of the questions module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/questions

List questions (admin)

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `productId` in query (string, optional).
- `search` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Questions retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/questions/{id}/answer

Answer product question (admin)

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [AnswerQuestionAdminDto](#answerquestionadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Answer added.
- `201`: no description. Body: object.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Question not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/questions/{id}/approve

Approve question

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Question approved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Question not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/questions/{id}/reject

Reject question

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [ModerateReviewDto](#moderatereviewdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Question rejected.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Question not found.

## Schemas

### AnswerQuestionAdminDto

- `answer` (string, min length 1, max length 5000, required).
- `isAdminAnswer` (boolean, optional).

### ModerateReviewDto

- `reason` (string, max length 1000, optional).
